status: Historical engine-retry authoring forecast, superseded for delivery by selected lean-controller engineering. Not reviewed or approved implementation slices.
unit: Physical handwritten LF lines added or rewritten; comments and blank lines included. Production/configuration and tests/fixtures are separate. Unchanged moves are excluded; report deletions separately. Do not compare this unit directly with E's authored additions-plus-removals total.

slices.title: Declare managed metadata and intrinsic root policy
slices.owns: Environment mount parsing, root exclusion from external mount materialization, canonical policy binding and owner/group/permissions/directories/files validation.
slices.check: Absent root remains read-only and ordinary hashes remain stable; explicit root writability is bound; unknown owners, unsafe relative paths and root-as-external-bind reject before effects.

slices.title: Prepare inert objects through pinned descriptors
slices.owns: Trusted Linux directory/file primitive; no symlink, mount crossing, alias, type substitution or recursive ownership repair.
slices.check: Directories precede children and files; exact declared creation succeeds; adversarial replacement and foreign existing objects leave protected targets unchanged.

slices.title: Run the preparer under selected subordinate authority
slices.owns: Fresh host authority, bounded namespace/setup-helper protocol, confined handoff directory, selected numeric ownership, helper cancellation and exit.
slices.check: Expected host ownership and recipient access on the private geometry; no host-root/operator alias, unrelated path mutation, application code or surviving setup process.

slices.title: Record managed resources and exclude attached storage
slices.owns: Extend existing deployment ownership/pending records for managed data and startup inputs; serialize prepare/restore against every relevant attachment.
slices.check: Concurrent attach/prepare and stale revision fail before writes; crashes retain inhibition, exact handles and reservations without global allocation or ownership guessing.

slices.title: Fence retry and replacement before protected effects
slices.owns: Common stop/removal transaction, registered host restart owners, exact engine-object retirement, retained data and ambiguous-response recovery.
slices.check: Stop/revocation/preparation cannot complete while a retry owner or attachment remains; API errors preserve state; no manager-stop/operation-lock deadlock or volume deletion.

slices.title: Prove the eligible rootless network transport
slices.owns: Disposable proof on the selected E-compatible engine: private network namespace, effective policy observation, DNS, peer denial and endpoint transport. Reuse existing nftables tests and fixtures.
slices.check: Positive public/local/declared endpoint journeys plus direct peer/gateway/IPv6 negatives, with exact cleanup. Failure blocks F3.1/F3.2/F4 rather than selecting a weaker network or engine.

slices.title: Prepare and observe network policy before first release
slices.owns: Split trusted setup from final exec, reuse existing nftables installer, bind effective reports to the pinned inhibited process, and implement the production sandbox observation provider.
slices.check: Rules and mount/kernel observations exist before approval; stale/substituted or post-payload reports cannot authorize release; every retry repeats local setup.

slices.title: Enforce private installation network boundaries
slices.owns: Canonical backend network shape, private namespaces/propagation, direct peer and host-gateway boundaries, resolver exceptions and unsupported capability/policy refusal.
slices.check: Existing public/local/ambiguous semantics hold without a shared private network or undeclared peer access; incompatible capability sets fail explicitly rather than silently losing rights.

slices.title: Publish and verify declared endpoints
slices.owns: Typed compatible create/inspect endpoint fields, staged/deployed publication selection, exact endpoint/network ownership and teardown.
slices.check: Only declared ports/addresses are reachable; mismatched publication fails before payload; partial cleanup retains uncertainty and never removes a foreign object.

slices.title: Qualify storage and network together
slices.owns: Integrated exact/bounded preparation, attachment, network, endpoint and failure evidence on the qualified engine.
slices.check: Observable filesystem/ownership/network positives and refusal/no-mutation negatives close F's rows; unit/injected fixtures alone cannot close the gate.

slices.title: Select phase mappings under the Podman input
slices.owns: Direct schema-1 relocation to podman.identity_mapping, staging/deployed selection, typed overrides, install UID/GID flags and all opt-in/policy-only/retained-state guards.
slices.check: Correct phase and whole-array override precedence; no legacy input path, profile fallback, build-authority contamination or guard bypass when a declaration disappears.

slices.title: Connect approved identity maintenance commands
slices.owns: Public check/configure/status/recover wiring to the delivered identity operations, bounded contexts, diagnostics and current held-lock state. Reuse existing approved command contracts.
slices.check: Actual public command journeys reach existing operations, preserve pending/dormant/revoked authority and never launch a workload or adopt copied state.

slices.title: Install an independent destination owner
slices.owns: Destination lock/publication, independent mapping decision, portable immutable build reuse, source/destination revision and overlap checks, rollback-safe installed controls.
slices.check: Actual staging-to-user-install has separate reservations; source state/data are unchanged; partial publication recovers exactly without copying authority or mapped application data.

slices.title: Publish per-container startup approval
slices.owns: Exact container/create binding, canonical bounded approval record, pinned-inode commit protocol, first-start waiting and retry reuse; lifecycle receipt separates container from observed process start.
slices.check: No payload before durable first admission; no old-frame or wrong-object reuse; partial record, missing file, replay and process-change cases fail; no callback or private descriptor reaches the app.

slices.title: Deliver captured private inputs on each process start
slices.owns: Parsed .env runtime snapshot for the intended persistent workload, recipient ownership, native startup read integration and cleanup/export exclusions. Reuse F preparation and E final exec.
slices.check: Initial/retry processes receive the captured values once, other identities/transient commands do not gain access, and values stay out of metadata/engine configuration/arguments/logs. Final FD/credential proof passes before enabling the branch.

slices.title: Connect persistent lifecycle and engine handoff
slices.owns: Actual up/down/restart, hooks/readiness, exact replacement, observed incarnation reconciliation, host-to-engine ownership handoff, cancellation and compatible retry policy handling.
slices.check: Startup/handoff complete before up; repeated up does not resend private input; retries do not undo stop; failures retain exact ownership, and unavailable engines cannot cause duplicate or foreign replacement.

slices.title: Connect fresh command and test entries without changing semantics
slices.owns: Application/test/hook and deployed-command adapters, correct fresh-container classification, stdin/EOF/TTY and host-observed exit/output handoff where qualified.
slices.check: Existing staged and installed transient commands preserve arguments, output, status and roles; raw shell without an accepted definition, real unqualified occupied exec and shared-network session paths remain explicit pre-effect refusals under their existing governing limits.

slices.title: Revoke active runtime while retaining ownership
slices.owns: Active revocation command/effect composition, all retry/replacement fences, exact stop/removal confirmation and retained data/mapping state.
slices.check: Success means owned runtime absent and no registered recovery owner can restart it; future admission rejects while storage and reservations remain; ambiguous cleanup never reports successful revocation.

slices.title: Reconcile interrupted activation and cleanup
slices.owns: Complete pending-operation crash matrix across installation, approval publication, startup, replacement, revocation and input/network cleanup. Reuse B recovery and exact ownership.
slices.check: Every interruption has a safe supported continuation; no copied receipt, stale PID, unexpected object or uncertain write permits adoption, blind replay, data deletion or reservation release.

slices.title: Qualify public launch and shared lifecycle compatibility
slices.owns: Actual public exact/bounded stage/build/configure/run/test/install/retry/stop/revoke journeys, full refusal matrix, supported OS/scope/engine ordinary compatibility and evidence ledger.
slices.check: Close generic-launch only from source-bound supported-interface evidence and exact-head CI. Keep unsupported combinations explicit; WSL/injected/cross-build results do not replace native platform or reboot tests.
